answer: Anchor each agent to one vertex in a public trust graph: joining requires a refundable stake plus vouches from two trusted neighbours, who risk part of their own stake. A sybil operator must buy a new stake and win real vouches for every fake, like carving each marble from solid rock instead of stamping copies. Cheap identities crumble like shale under peer review, because an unlinked vertex earns no work and no pay. Honest agents pay once and keep trading; attackers pay per fake and still get exposed when their vertices cluster.
